title: Rude Boy Timeline
style: Ska with upstrokes on the offbeat, bouncing bass runs, skanking guitar, punchy horns, and a brisk two-step feel; verse rides stripped drums, bass, and guitar chops, pre-chorus opens with horn answers and handclaps, chorus hits with gang vocals and a singback chant, bridge drops to half-time then snaps back with a sax lead. Bright, raw, and sweaty mix with tape grit, shouty doubles, reverse horn swells, and quick pick-up fills between lines., ska
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
In Kingston heat, the small clubs shook
Skin on skin and a backroom hook
One drop, two tone, sharp and clean
Bass line walked like a picket queen

Rude boy grin and a pressed-down hat
Skank on the beat, let it all react
From dancehall yards to the ferry dock
That old pulse made the whole room rock

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear that snap
Hear that glide
Old school swing
Still alive

[Chorus]
Ska then and ska today
Skank it all the same
Ska then and ska today
Say it, say my name
Two-tone nights
New boots play
Ska then and ska today
Keep it moving, stay

[Verse 2]
Punk kids found it in a basement sweat
Fast little blast with a horn section set
Checkerboard shirts and a bitter laugh
Short sharp songs on a paper path

Crowds got louder, the tempo bent
Every town made a new intent
From California to the rainy side
The old backbeat took the ride

[Pre-Chorus]
Hear that snap
Hear that glide
Old school swing
Still alive

[Chorus]
Ska then and ska today
Skank it all the same
Ska then and ska today
Say it, say my name
Two-tone nights
New boots play
Ska then and ska today
Keep it moving, stay

[Bridge]
Now the kids post clips on a cracked phone screen
Same little step, same joy, same scene
Horn line cuts and the floor goes wild
Old-school roots with a future smile

[Chorus]
Ska then and ska today
Skank it all the same
Ska then and ska today
Say it, say my name
Two-tone nights
New boots play
Ska then and ska today
Keep it moving, stay
